meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会写小脚本操作浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、抓取页面数据,也能测试网站。每个脚本只做一件事,页面状态在多次脚本执行之间保留。
howto.when: 当你要求打开某网址、填写表单或截图,或提出抓取数据、测试网站等浏览器交互需求时,它会接管。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图给我看
say.note: 启动浏览器并返回页面截图

say.text: 帮我登录这个网站并提交表单
say.note: 扩展模式可接管你已登录的 Chrome

say.text: 把 Hacker News 首页前几条标题抓下来
say.note: 先取页面快照定位元素,再提取文本

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes small scripts to drive a browser: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract page data. Each script does one thing and page state persists across script runs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to go to a URL, fill a form, take a screenshot, scrape data, test a site, or any other browser interaction.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Launches a browser and returns the screenshot

say_en.text: Log into this site and submit the form
say_en.note: Extension mode drives your logged-in Chrome

say_en.text: Scrape the top headlines from Hacker News
say_en.note: Locates elements via snapshot, then extracts text
